notes.title: The Last 66 Days now supports macOS
notes.notes:
Dear family members who are still following The Last 66 Days:

Good morning!
I am Xiran! Xiran who stayed up all night yesterday!
My college life is so hard before it even starts! Countless trainings and assignments have already overwhelmed me! **Crying**! I don't know how everyone has been recently. The only thing that can make me a little happier recently is that I received a Mac from my parents for college... Therefore, I contacted the publisher and rushed to work with them all night. Finally, we produced the macOS version of "Countdown 66 Days" for some players who only have Macs to play.
While making the macOS version, I also reminisced about the previous story. In the past, for his one sentence, I actually made an entire game. Even half a year later, I admire my courage and perseverance at that time, as well as my... I can't say exactly what this feeling is... Is it the beginning of first love? Or what? In retrospect, this may not be true love. Does anyone here have any thoughts?
But... I really like the feeling of being in love - although I haven't been in a relationship before, everything is just my fantasy - I like it when someone can ask me about my well-being when I come back tired. I also like many intimate gestures, like kissing, hugging, and lifting up high... But in fact, when I think about it, I'm not that excellent. Alas, sorry, I'm publicly daydreaming here. Everyone may think that my life is great, but in fact, I personally think it's just so-so. Whether it's "him" or someone else, it seems that in my life I have never been truly affirmed or truly loved. Thinking about it is a bit sad. I... have nowhere else to talk, so I can only complain to everyone here. I know that not many people read this, so I can safely regard it as a small diary. Every time I update a little bit, I come to talk to everyone. There aren't many people, and I feel very relieved, hahaha.
I don't know how long I can stay here with everyone. In fact, my mental state is not very good. I often feel wronged and shed tears for no reason by myself. Huddled in a corner alone, there is no one to talk to. If you want to hear me say something, you can leave your contact information below. When I have time, I will visit one by one. Haha. It's a kind of making friends in a roundabout way. Yes, I don't have many friends. It can almost be said that I have none. With many people, it's only a superficial friendship. In fact, I may not really agree with them in my heart, but it's just to the extent that I don't want to ruin the relationship.
Then let's stop here for today. This goblin is going back to the cave to sleep. Bye.
See you if fate allows.

One more thing: Sorry, I used machine translation and didn't review it carefully. Because as long as you finish reading this article, you will know that I am very tired now and in urgent need of rest. Some slang may not be translated correctly. So the best way to read all the correct meanings of this article is to find a friend who understands Chinese. I hope you can understand me. Thank you.

Xiran
9/5/2024

notes.title: The team of The Last 66 Days wish all students the best of luck on their exam!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players, and all you prospective students:
 
Hi, I'm Xiran! I apologize for my late arrival. Recently it's the China college entrance exam season, and my story is a story of growing up on the road of youth. Before the entrance exam, I was also a senior in high school, and I was also tired, sleepy, hardworking and struggling for the entrance exam. With this spirit of mine and everyone else's, just like Anna in The Last 66 Days, I don't think all the results matter as long as we are brave enough to go through it. What matters is the courage to try even though the future is full of unknowns. Isn't it?
The China college entrance examination has come to an end, and then dwell on the past is meaningless, which can not change the result. Let's look forward together, embrace the light of the future, and look forward to a better tomorrow!
I, along with Next Playground, the publisher who has supported me for so long, would like to wish you all the best of luck in your China college entrance exams, and to get into the school of your choice with the one you love (if there is one)! I wish you all a colorful college life!

Xiran
6/17/2024

notes.title: The Last 66 Days has now surpassed 66 purchases and activations!
notes.notes:
As of 10:43 PM BST on March 23, 2024, The Last 66 Days has now reached 66 purchases and activations!
For me, "66" is a special number. It symbolizes my last moments with him, so when I saw tonight that the number of purchases and activations was exactly 66, I felt compelled to make it public. I'd like to thank the 66 people who stopped by to hear my story, and I'd like to thank those of you in front of your screens who have been willing to follow my daily life!
After so many days, I've almost gotten over the haze of this incident, and I've begun to study and manage my relationships normally. However, the story of me and "him" will always be the warmest memory in my mind. Even though it didn't work out for me at the time, I'm still grateful to have met "him" and to all the people I've found here who have resonated with this story - including you!
Thank you for your interest!

Xiran
3/23/2024

notes.title: The Last 66 Days is now available in Traditional Chinese!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone:

As previously agreed between me and you all, the localization of the game in Traditional Chinese has now been completed in the hope of helping more players read the story without any barriers~!
Since the translation was done by myself, and I'm not proficient in Traditional Chinese, and I used a lot of machine translation to save effort, I'd like to apologize for any possible mistranslations in the content. I would like to apologize for any possible mistranslations in the content. I would be grateful if you could criticize me for any mistranslations, thank you!
Note: If your game still displays Simplified Chinese, you just need switch the language of your Steam client to Traditional Chinese, uninstall the game, and reinstall it.
I wish you all success in your endeavors in the new year, and I also wish you all a speedy meeting with the person you deserve to share the rest of your life with!

Xiran

notes.title: The Last 66 Days is now released
notes.notes:
The Last 66 Days has now been successfully released. We would like to thank you all for your support during the development phase and before the release!
I wish you all a happy new year!

notes.title: The Last 66 Days release date has now been announced!
notes.notes:
Good morning, noon, and night, everyone, I'm Xiran, and I'm thrilled to be announcing the release time of my video game, The Last 66 Days, today! For those of you who don't know, The Last 66 Days is a visual novel based on a relationship story that I've experienced, and while it may be a bit boring, it's been a labor of love for me for the past two months or so. Finally, I've decided to announce today that The Last 66 Days will be released on January 1, 2024 CST (which is also December 31, 2023 PST). As a developer, I've always believed that games are a kind of art that can transcend language and geography, connecting all kinds of empathetic players around the world. So for those of you who use Traditional Chinese, I will be localizing the game as soon as possible after release. Next, I'm happy to reveal a bit of my entire process and mental journey in developing this game so far, for all you prospective gamers out there~! 

(As my English is limited and I use a lot of slang in my diary, in order to leave the original meaning as unaltered as possible, I will provide the content of my diary as it is in my native language, Simplified Chinese, for which I apologize.)

[list]
[*] 2023/10/27：他告诉我他要离开了，所以我开始制作了这个游戏给他作为道别礼。我必须得在 2024 年新年之前完成上架，不然就来不及了。
[*] 2023/10/29：根据和他过往的经历大致剧情走向写好了。一共 1264 个字。
[*] 2023/11/01：把大致剧情走向丢给 AI 再加上自己改写与补充，完成了一稿。一共 2652 字。
[*] 2023/11/03：和几个人分享了自己的剧本，发现了个巨大的问题——一稿太短了。一般人可能在 5-10 分钟内就读完了。接下来必须要扩展一稿规模或者另起一稿。
[*] 2023/11/04：仔细斟酌后发现一稿主要是基于我和他之间的重要事件改编，注定写不出什么花样来。日常聊天中的那些废话，才是产生感情最重要的因素。决定推翻一稿重新撰写二稿，内容基于我和他之间的所有聊天记录。
[*] 2023/11/06：二稿撰写完成，共 8383 个字。这次的字数终于提升到约二十分钟的游戏时长了，同时还加入了只有达成某些特殊条件才能触发的隐藏结局。具体内容保密~
[*] 2023/11/07：还是发现了问题，二稿还是太短，而且人物语言风格过于相似，虽然这是基于真实内容改编，但是在游戏中还是容易给玩家们造成两个人就像同一个人说的话的错觉。开始根据问题略微修改二稿，定为三稿。
[*] 2023/11/08：三稿撰写完成，同时也修改掉了一些二稿的逻辑 Bug 以及影响玩家正常阅读的句子。奇怪，三稿修改完也是 8383 个字。理论完成，准备上实践——游戏化开始！
[*] 2023/11/10：完成三稿剧本游戏化过程。即将开始着手准备背景图、立绘、背景音乐等附加内容。提前做好上架准备，开始申请注册 TapTap 开发者账号。
[*] 2023/11/11：从免版权素材网站上挑了一些音频作为游戏背景音乐以及部分背景图。同时其他背景图与立绘的约稿于今日开始，因为鄙人不怎么会画画……一共花了 610r，饭都要吃不起了……
[*] 2023/11/12：通过编辑源代码定制了游戏引擎的 UI；炁清角色立绘绘制完成，等待安娜的人物立绘中…
[*] 2023/11/14：研究了一晚上的 TapSDK，最终决定使用 TapPlay (因为我是没有任何一点的 Android 开发经验啊……)。
[*] 2023/11/16：本来打算用 TapTap 在国内发布的，但是突然发现在大陆发行需要版号，最终还是决定拥抱 Steam 了。开始申请注册 Steam 开发者账号。
[*] 2023/11/17：早上收到了 Steam 的审核通过通知，耶！准备开始着手上架 Steam。
[*] 2023/11/18：立绘画师说今天能完成两幅人物立绘，拭目以待。
[*] 2023/11/19：好好好，立绘还是拖到了今天，不过问题不大。将人物的立绘插入了游戏，游戏只差标题图就完工了。
[*] 2023/11/20：标题图新鲜出炉！终于可以提交 Steam 商店页面了，提交了商店页面等待审核中。
[*] 2023/11/21：游戏制作的最后部分完成，提交整个游戏等待审核喽！
[*] 2023/11/23：审核不通过，因为添加了太多链接。现在把这类链接移到官方网站了，看看审核能不能过。不过快要到周末了，估计得等到下周才能出结果了。
[*] 2023/11/26：审核过了！终于！！上架环节终于结束咯，坐等发行~
[/list]

notes.title: The Last 66 Days now officially opens for Steam wishlist reservations!
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, I'm Xiran, the developer of The Last 66 Days! Welcome to the store page that was hastily built just a little while ago.
The plot of the game is based on my real life chat with him. My character is quite strange, I'm not sure why I fell in love with him so quickly (I met him on around October 10th, just a few days after I confessed my love for him), and I've heard people say that they seem to have a personality that can't help but be moved by the other person if they give a little bit of themselves to them, but I don't know that for sure either.) However, even though we only have 66 days left (of course, for today, it's only 36 days), I want to make this game as a goodbye gift to him, so that I won't have any regrets.
It was his idea to make this game in the first place. I had written a short story about him and I, and he said that if I expanded the plot and turned it into a visual novel, it would be a hit with many people who could relate to it. On the one hand, as a farewell gift to him, and on the other hand, I want to try a new field, so I came to make a game, thanks to God's arrangement that I can meet you guys to savor my story with him~!
It's really hard to make a game by myself, I have to think about the illustrations and the plot, and I also have to read the revised script to my friends and family from time to time (although not many people have read the script). I thought of giving up a few times in the middle of the process, but luckily I had a lot of encouragement from many people to keep me going, so I'd like to express my deepest gratitude~.
This is my first time making a game, and the plot is on the everyday side, so it might be a bit boring. I'm well aware of this, but I don't have the talent to change it on my own, and it's not realistic to find someone else to change it, I've already invested too much time and money into this game >_<. So I'll understand any of you to get refunds from the Steam, after all, I'm the one who did a terrible job. But I'm still very happy that people are willing to read my story.
The last thing I want to say sorry is about my funding. I have put so much money into this game that I had to make it a pay-to-play system in order to get my money back. Every time you purchase the game, you are supporting me greatly and I am honored. Of course, as mentioned above, if you found the story too boring, I do understand that you got a refund through Steam. It was poorly crafted on my part, and I'll be sure to work on it more in the future!
Thank you for reading this far. If you don't mind, add The Last 66 Days to your wishlist so you can guide me through one last look at my story with him before he leaves. Thanks!
